subject: Upcoming Travel Itinerary
body: Dear [Recipient], I hope this email finds you well. I am writing to share the details of your upcoming travel itinerary. Your flight is scheduled for Wednesday, June 15th, departing at 9:00 AM from JFK International Airport. Please remember to check-in online 24 hours prior to departure. Your hotel reservation is confirmed at the Grand City Hotel, and a car service will be waiting for you at the airport. If you have any questions or need assistance, feel free to contact us. Safe travels! Best regards, [Your Name]
